3: const commander = require('commander');
4: const fs = require('fs');
5: 
6: const { fixDuplicates, listDuplicates } = require('./index');
7: const version = require('./package.json').version;
8: 
9: commander
10:     .version(version)
11:     .usage('[options] [yarn.lock path (default: yarn.lock)]')
12:     .option(
13:         '-s, --strategy <strategy>',
14:         'deduplication strategy. Valid values: fewer, highest. Default is "highest"',
15:         'highest'
16:     )
17:     .option('-l, --list', 'do not change yarn.lock, just output the diagnosis')
18:     .option(
19:         '-f, --fail',
20:         'if there are duplicates in yarn.lock, terminate the script with exit status 1'
21:     )
22:     .option(
23:         '--scopes <scopes>',
24:         'a comma separated list of scopes to deduplicate. Defaults to all packages.',
25:         (val) => val.split(',').map((v) => v.trim())
26:     )
27:     .option(
28:         '--packages <packages>',
29:         'a comma separated list of packages to deduplicate. Defaults to all packages.',
30:         (val) => val.split(',').map((v) => v.trim())
31:     )
32:     .option(
33:         '--exclude <exclude>',
34:         'a comma separated list of packages not to deduplicate.',
35:         (val) => val.split(',').map((v) => v.trim())
36:     )
37:     .option('--print', 'instead of saving the deduplicated yarn.lock, print the result in stdout');
38: 
39: commander.parse(process.argv);
40: 
41: if (commander.scopes && commander.packages) {
42:     console.error('Please specify either scopes or packages, not both.');
43:     commander.help();
44: }
45: 
46: if (commander.strategy !== 'highest' && commander.strategy !== 'fewer') {
47:     console.error(`Invalid strategy ${commander.strategy}`);
48:     commander.help();
49: }
50: 
51: const file = commander.args.length ? commander.args[0] : 'yarn.lock';
52: 
53: try {
54:     const yarnLock = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
55:     const useMostCommon = commander.strategy === 'fewer';
56: 
57:     if (commander.list) {
58:         const duplicates = listDuplicates(yarnLock, {
59:             useMostCommon,
60:             includeScopes: commander.scopes,
61:             includePackages: commander.packages,
62:             excludePackages: commander.exclude,
63:         });
64:         duplicates.forEach((logLine) => console.log(logLine));
65:         if (commander.fail && duplicates.length > 0) {
66:             process.exit(1);
67:         }
68:     } else {
69:         let dedupedYarnLock = fixDuplicates(yarnLock, {
70:             useMostCommon,
71:             includeScopes: commander.scopes,
72:             includePackages: commander.packages,
73:             excludePackages: commander.exclude,
74:         });
75: 
76:         if (commander.print) {
77:             console.log(dedupedYarnLock);
78:         } else {
79:             const eolMatch = yarnLock.match(/(\r?\n)/);
80:             if (eolMatch && eolMatch[0] === '\r\n') {
81:                 dedupedYarnLock = dedupedYarnLock.replace(/\n/g, '\r\n');
82:             }
83:             fs.writeFileSync(file, dedupedYarnLock);
84:         }
85: 
86:         if (commander.fail && yarnLock !== dedupedYarnLock) {
87:             process.exit(1);
88:         }
89:     }
